anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: 5–7 L. ca. 23 Z. at head of page; dots kept.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.
pass_a_gloss: [gap] that the true sheep is Christ, because of his being second after the Father, through the second monad — I mean the number ten — he is taken.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] that the [true] sheep is Christ, because he, being [second] after the [Father], is taken through the second monad — I mean the number ten.
source_text: ... ο ... ενος ... δος ι ... ετ ... μ ... ται· ομ[ ... λ]αμβαν ... η λαμβ[αν..]ῖν ... ν ὅτι τὸ [ἀλ]ηθὲς π[ρόβατο]ν Χ(ριστό)[ς] ἐστιν [δι]ὰ τὸ δ[εύτε]ρον αὐ[τὸ]ν ὄντα μετὰ τὸ[ν π(ατέ)ρα] διὰ τῆς δευτέρας μον[άδος], λέγω δὲ τοῦ δέκα ἀρι[θμο]ῦ, λαμβάνεσθαι.
